description:
A social historian is studying class stratification aboard the Titanic. Using the TitanicSurvival dataset, perform a multinomial logistic regression in Jamovi to predict passenger class (1st, 2nd, or 3rd) from survival status, sex, and age.

Steps:
1. Open the file '~/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicSurvival.csv' in Jamovi (File > Open > navigate to the file).
2. Go to Analyses > Regression > Logistic Regression > N Outcomes (Multinomial Logistic Regression).
3. Set 'passengerClass' as the Dependent Variable.
4. Add 'survived' and 'sex' as Factors (categorical predictors).
5. Add 'age' as Covariates (continuous predictor).
6. Under 'Model Fit', enable the overall model test and pseudo R-squared measures (McFadden, Cox & Snell, Nagelkerke).
7. Under 'Model Coefficients', enable 'Odds ratio' to display exponentiated coefficients.
8. Save the completed analysis file as '~/Documents/Jamovi/MultinomialTitanic.omv' (File > Save As).
